about_the_game:
※For the best experience, please enable voice playback in the options menu.

Masamune Kashin and Amelie Blanshett are young mages serving in
the Magic Corps of the Greatland Kingdom.They were given a mission—to infiltrate Caledonia Magic Academy and conduct an undercover investigation.

Their objective is to determine whether the rumors of demon summoning within the academy are true.Kashin assumed it would be a simple task, just handling some students.

But then, his superior revealed something shocking…Driven by ambition, Amelie was determined to see the mission through.
For her, it was a chance to elevate the reputation of mages everywhere.Beside her, Kashin remained optimistic—his thoughts already drifting elsewhere.

"Just the two of us on this mission... I’ll tell her how I feel this time for sure."

Kashin has long harbored feelings for Amelie, the girl who grew up with him and taught him magic.

However, within Caledonia Magic Academy, countless thoughts and intentions are already beginning to intertwine.Amelie Blanshett’s charm hasn’t captured only Kashin’s heart—others, too, find themselves drawn to her.

What seemed like a simple assignment turns into a relentless trial, and Kashin keeps falling short, again and again.

At that moment, a mysterious girl appeared—changing everything.

Under the influence of magic, the week falls into an endless cycle—repeating again and again.

And so, the story begins—but where will it end...?

Amelie Blanshett

【Height】163cm

【Place of Origin】Great Land Kingdom

She has shown talent in magic since childhood, and her abilities were recognized, leading to an invitation to join the Magic Corps.

She is like an elder sister figure to the protagonist.

She has a kind and cheerful personality, and is diligent and hardworking.

Jackson Steinfeld

Representative of the Magic Research Club in his third year.

Talented in magic, ambitious.

Has a personality that doesn't hesitate to use any means for his goals.

Leon Amador

He is handsome and kind, and gets along well with everyone.

He has a complex about not having much talent in magic.

He likes girls, and has several ex-girlfriends among his classmates.

Hiori Kamono

She has a modest and earnest personality.

She has good grades and is trusted by the teachers.

She belongs to the Student Council.

Elena Fontaine

She likes handsome guys and is the center of attention in her class.

She has a tough personality, but she is devoted to the person she loves.

She belongs to the Magic Research Club.

Professor Hoffman

He is a professor of magic and the advisor to the student council.

He is very strict with the school rules and is not popular among students.

He is also strict with female students as a teacher.

Caledonia Magic University

A prestigious magic school located in the northern part of the Great Land Kingdom.

It has the longest history among magic schools and has produced numerous famous wizards.

There are various clubs related to magic, such as the Magic Research Club.

The northern region is the front line of the battle against demons, and monsters occasionally emerge, resulting in poor public safety.

  • Classic JRPG

  • Exploration

  • Puzzle-solving

  • Diverse maps

  • Rich storyline content

  • Turn-based combat
